startUrls.title: Websites or sitemap URLs
startUrls.description: Required. Array of objects, e.g. [{"url":"https://example.com"}] or [{"url":"https://example.com/sitemap.xml"}]. A home page triggers sitemap auto-discovery (robots.txt + common paths); a sitemap URL is read directly.

maxUrls.title: Max URLs (total)
maxUrls.description: Stop after this many URLs across all sites (default 1000; 0 = no limit). Large sites list 100k+ URLs: raise this deliberately. Also applies to API and AI-agent calls that omit it.

maxUrlsPerSite.title: Max URLs per site
maxUrlsPerSite.description: Stop after this many URLs from each start URL (0 = no limit). Useful when one big site would use up maxUrls.

includeUrlPatterns.title: Include URL patterns
includeUrlPatterns.description: Only output URLs matching at least one pattern. Use a glob (e.g. */blog/*) or a regular expression (e.g. /products/\d+). Case-insensitive.

excludeUrlPatterns.title: Exclude URL patterns
excludeUrlPatterns.description: Drop URLs matching any of these globs or regular expressions (e.g. */tag/*).

lastmodFrom.title: Modified after
lastmodFrom.description: Only URLs whose lastmod date is on/after this date. Absolute (2026-01-31) or relative (7 days, 24 hours, 2 weeks). URLs without lastmod are excluded when a date filter is set.

lastmodTo.title: Modified before
lastmodTo.description: Only URLs whose lastmod date is on/before this date. Absolute or relative.

onlyNewUrls.title: Only new URLs since the last run (monitoring)
onlyNewUrls.description: Remembers URLs between runs (in a named key-value store) and outputs only URLs not seen before. The first run outputs everything and saves the baseline. Ideal with a schedule to get alerts on new pages, products or articles.

stateKey.title: Monitoring state key
stateKey.description: Optional name for the remembered URL set. Defaults to a hash of the start URLs. Use different keys for independent monitors.

checkUrlStatus.title: Check HTTP status of every URL
checkUrlStatus.description: Sends a HEAD request (GET fallback) to each output URL and adds httpStatus and finalUrl (redirect target). Finds broken (404) and redirected sitemap entries. Slower; charged as an extra event per URL.

statusCheckConcurrency.title: Status check concurrency
statusCheckConcurrency.description: How many HTTP status checks run at the same time (only with checkUrlStatus). Lower it if the site rate-limits you.

includeImages.title: Include image URLs
includeImages.description: Add the image URLs listed for each page (image:loc tags in image sitemaps).

includeAlternates.title: Include hreflang alternates
includeAlternates.description: Add hreflang language alternates (xhtml:link tags) for each page.

restrictToStartPath.title: Restrict to start URL path
restrictToStartPath.description: When a start URL has a path (e.g. https://example.com/blog/), output only URLs under that path and try that path's own sitemap first.

discoverFromRobotsTxt.title: Discover sitemaps from robots.txt
discoverFromRobotsTxt.description: Read Sitemap: lines from /robots.txt when a website (not a sitemap) is given.

tryCommonSitemapPaths.title: Try common sitemap paths
tryCommonSitemapPaths.description: If robots.txt lists no sitemap, try /sitemap.xml, /sitemap_index.xml, /wp-sitemap.xml, /sitemap.txt and similar.

maxSitemapDepth.title: Max sitemap index depth
maxSitemapDepth.description: How deep to follow nested sitemap indexes.

maxSitemaps.title: Max sitemap files
maxSitemaps.description: Safety limit on the number of sitemap files fetched per run.

sitemapConcurrency.title: Sitemap download concurrency
sitemapConcurrency.description: Sitemap files fetched in parallel per site.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Timeout for each sitemap or status-check HTTP request, in seconds.

maxRetries.title: Max retries per request
maxRetries.description: Retries on network errors, 403, 429 and 5xx with exponential backoff (honours Retry-After).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Usually not needed — sitemaps are meant for bots. Enable Apify Proxy only for sites that block datacenter traffic.

emitStatusRows.title: Add status rows for empty sites
emitStatusRows.description: Add one free row (status "no_results" plus a reason) for each start URL that returned no URLs, so you or an AI agent can see why. Not charged. Turn off for a pure URL list.
